title: A Glasshouse for the Aftermath
author: Astrid Amberdale
blurb: Sebastian Marchetti, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
